lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan meet sakhaa har merai gun goupaal har raaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my Best Friend, my Buddy, my Companion. I sing the Glorious Praises of my Sovereign Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bisar na jaaee nimakh hiradai te poorai guroo milaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: I shall not forget Him in my heart, even for an instant; I have met with the Perfect Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhe daas apane jee ja(n)t vas jaa kai ||
lines.translation: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; all beings and creatures are in His Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੨॥੭੩॥੯੬॥
lines.transliteration: ekaa liv pooran paramesur bhau nahee naanak taa kai ||2||73||96||
lines.translation: One who is lovingly attuned to the One, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God, O Nanak, is rid of all fear. ||2||73||96||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai raam ko bal hoi ||
lines.translation: One who has the Lord's Power on his side

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooran taahoo ke dookh na biaapai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: - all his desires are fulfilled, and no pain afflicts him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhagat daas nij prabh kaa sun jeevaa(n) tis soi ||
lines.translation: That humble devotee is a slave of his God, who listens to Him, and so lives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕੌ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: udam karau darasan pekhan kau karam paraapat hoi ||1||
lines.translation: I have made the effort to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; it is obtained only by good karma. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee drisat nihaarau doosar naahee koi ||
lines.translation: It is only by Guru's Grace that I see His Vision with my eyes which none can equal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥੭੪॥੯੭॥
lines.transliteration: daan dehi naanak apane kau charan jeevaa(n) sa(n)t dhoi ||2||74||97||
lines.translation: Please bless Nanak with this Gift, that he may wash the Feet of the Saints, and so live. ||2||74||97||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat raam ke gun gaai ||
lines.translation: I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੇ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa gopaal beethule bisar na kab hee jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please be Merciful to me, O my Loving Lord of the Universe, that I may never forget You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan dhan sabh tumaraa suaamee aan na doojee jaai ||
lines.translation: My mind, body, wealth and all are Yours, O my Lord and Master; there is nowhere else for me at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਪੈਨੑੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu too raakhahi tiv hee rahanaa tumhraa painhai khaai ||1||
lines.translation: As You keep me, so do I survive; I eat and I wear whatever You give me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai bal bal jaaee bahuR na janamaa dhaai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I shall never again fall into reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥੭੫॥੯੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai ||2||75||98||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sancuary, Lord; as it pleases Your Will, so do You guide him. ||2||75||98||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re naam ko sukh saar ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Naam is the most sublime peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਕਾਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan kaam bikaar maaiaa sagal deesahi chhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Other affairs of Maya are corrupt. They are nothing more than dust. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਤਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: grihi a(n)dh koop patit praanee narak ghor gubaar ||
lines.translation: The mortal has fallen into the deep dark pit of household attachment; it is a horrible, dark hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik jonee bhramat haario bhramat baara(n) baar ||1||
lines.translation: He wanders in various incarnations, growing weary; he wanders through them again and again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan bhagat bachhal deen kirapaa dhaar ||
lines.translation: O Purifier of sinners, O Lover of Your devotees, please shower Your Mercy on Your meek servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੬॥੯੯॥
lines.transliteration: kar joR naanak daan maa(n)gai saadhasa(n)g udhaar ||2||76||99||
lines.translation: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, please save me in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||76||99||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: biraajit raam ko parataap ||
lines.translation: The Glorious Radiance of the Lord has spread out everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੀਨੈ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aadh biaadh upaadh sabh naasee binase teenai taap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The doubts of my mind and body are all erased, and I am rid of the three diseases. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa bujhee pooran sabh aasaa chooke sog sa(n)taap ||
lines.translation: My thirst is quenched, and my hopes have all been fulfilled; my sorrows and sufferings are over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee man tan aatam dhraap ||1||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, my mind, body and soul are comforted and encouraged. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad matasar saadhoo kai sa(n)g khaap ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed, pride and envy are destroyed in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੭੭॥੧੦੦॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai kaatanahaare naanak ke maaee baap ||2||77||100||
lines.translation: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; O Nanak, He is our Mother and Father. ||2||77||100||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatur naam bin sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is miserable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tripat na hovat kookaree aasaa it laago bikhiaa chhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Like a dog, its desires are never satisfied; it clings to the ashes of corruption. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ਜਨਮਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paai thagauree aap bhulaaio janamat baaro baar ||
lines.translation: Administering the intoxicating drug, God Himself leads the mortals astray; they are reincarnated again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa simaran nimakh na simario jamaka(n)kar karat khuaar ||1||
lines.translation: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death makes him suffer. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bha(n)jan teriaa sa(n)tah kee raavaar ||
lines.translation: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints.
